name: ZX902-AFG-411NS（EN）.pdf
text:
[p1]
Datasheet
6-Port Gigabit PoE Switch
Product Highlights
n 4* 1G PoE ports+1* 1G RJ45 port+1* 1G SFP port
n Complies with IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, IEEE 802.3z, and IEEE 802.3x
standards
n RJ45 port supports 10M/100M/1G adaptation
n PoE port automatically turns on the PoE watchdog mode in VLAN and Extend modes
n Flow control method: Full duplex uses IEEE 802.3x standard, while half duplex uses Back
pressure standard
n Supports automatic port flipping (Auto MDI/MDIX)
n Adopting a storage and forwarding exchange mechanism
n The panel indicator LED will monitor the working status and assist in fault analysis
n Supports VLAN, Default, and Extend modes
n Port 1 supports HiPoE 60W
